content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR-NEERI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.text: B.Sc. in Chemistry/ Environmental Science/ Botany/ Microbiology Zoology from recognized University

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant-II position at CSIR-NEERI is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Environmental Science, Botany, Microbiology, or Zoology from a recognized university to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant-II post is 35 years. No minimum age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, ST, Women) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this CSIR-NEERI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at CSIR-NEERI, Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500007. The exact address will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Assistant-II announced by CSIR-NEERI in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the position of Project Assistant-II is on a contractual basis. It is a temporary engagement for a specific project duration.
